card.name: Opening parentheses and codes after names
card.fires_on: The opening parenthesis after a person or drug name, and the first characters of a bracketed tag such as CYP enzyme codes (the 2 in CYP2D6) or a band name in brackets.

modes.label: Parenthesis after a name
modes.description: An opening bracket right after a person's or drug's name, before an aside such as a band or brand name.
modes.example: Rock musician Lee Ranaldo<< (>>Sonic Youth) is 57

modes.label: Inside CYP enzyme codes
modes.description: The digit or letters inside a CYP enzyme code in a parenthesis after a drug name.

card.plain: It fires on the start of a bracketed aside after a name, and on the characters inside enzyme codes like CYP2D6.
